patterns.note: Sections utilize a dark, full-bleed background with content often centered or left-aligned, creating a focused and immersive experience.
The hero section features an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typeface for the product name 'Seeker', establishing a dominant visual hierarchy that contrasts with smaller, legible body text.
A predominantly dark color scheme (near-black to deep charcoal) is used for backgrounds and surfaces, accented by bright white text and a vibrant electric blue for CTAs and interactive elements.

The hero section features a layered parallax effect where the large 'Seeker' text scales down and moves slower than the background phone image as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and dynamic reveal.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, drawing attention to new information.
Feature sections frequently employ a split layout, pairing a prominent product image or graphic with concise descriptive text, or arranging information in a grid of distinct, dark-themed cards.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a sophisticated parallax effect using CSS keyframes, where the foreground text element scales down and translates vertically at a slower rate than the background video hero image, creating a dynamic sense of depth and reveal upon scroll.

Subsequent content sections are introduced with a scroll-triggered animation that subtly fades them in and slides them upwards as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

The site maintains a consistent dark, premium aesthetic by using deep charcoal and black backgrounds, contrasted with crisp white typography and vibrant accent colors for interactive elements, ensuring high readability and a modern feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) for brand and product names, with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, legible body and caption text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner radius on buttons, input fields, and some cards, maintaining a clean, modern edge).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus, while feature grids maintain good internal padding.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost architectural use of oversized typography in the hero, which dynamically scales and parallaxes with the background product image. This creates a highly immersive and sophisticated introduction that immediately conveys a premium, high-tech brand identity, setting it apart from typical marketing sites.
